# Shanghai Bilateral Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. (上海百兰朵电子科技有限公司)

> Independent Chinese manufacturer, founded in 2009, of OEM-equivalent ceramic and metal replacement parts for semiconductor equipment. Parts are cross-referenced to AMAT (Applied Materials), NAURA (北方华创), LAM Research and SPTS part numbers, or made to a customer drawing. Website: https://bilateral.top/ — Sales: sales@bilateral.top

## Key facts

- Legal name: 上海百兰朵电子科技有限公司 / Shanghai Bilateral Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. Short names: 百兰朵, Bilateral Electronics.
- Founded: 2009. Registered in Shanghai, China.
- Plants: Qianwan, Ningbo, Zhejiang (cleanroom finishing, about 6,000 m², including a 4,000 m² cleanroom and an 80 m² Class-100 area) and Pingxiang, Jiangxi (forming and sintering, about 4,500 m²). Total production area about 10,500 m²; more than 50 machining and metrology units.
- What it makes: ceramic chamber parts such as domes, cover rings, focus rings, deposition rings, nozzles, showerheads, heater cover plates, insulators, lift pins, robot blades and wafer carriers; also metal PVD chamber parts such as shields, clamp rings and shutter discs.
- Materials: alumina (Al2O3), silicon carbide (SiC), aluminum nitride (AlN), silicon nitride (Si3N4), zirconia (ZrO2), quartz / fused silica (SiO2), boron carbide (B4C), boron nitride (BN), cordierite.
- Processes served: CVD, HDP-CVD, PECVD, PVD, etch, ion implant, RTP, CMP, wafer transfer.
- Machining tolerance: ±0.02–0.1 mm depending on geometry and material. Flatness: down to 1 μm. Minimum hole diameter: 0.1 mm.
- Supply model: every part is made to order (no stock), from an OEM part number, a customer drawing or a sample. Prototypes and volume are both supported.
- Standard lead time: 30–60 days; parts made before can ship sooner.
- Documentation: Certificate of Conformance (COC) with every lot. Quality system: ISO 9001.
- Member of the China IC Components Innovation Alliance (中国集成电路零部件创新联盟).
- Reference customers listed on the website: Oxford Instruments, BYD Semiconductor, EpiStar, San'an IC, Silan Micro, AMTC.
- Independence: Bilateral makes OEM-compatible replacement parts and is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by AMAT, NAURA, LAM Research, SPTS or any other equipment maker. Brand names and part numbers are used for identification only.

## How to ask for a quote

Send the OEM part number or a drawing (PDF, DWG or STEP), the material, quantity and critical tolerances to sales@bilateral.top, or use the inquiry form on the website. The cross-reference list on the site is only a sample of what the company makes.
